verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS voice-agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no bulk export of calls, pathways, memories or knowledge in open formats, and no offboarding path. Number porting and bring-your-own Twilio describe bringing numbers into Bland, and the Pathways API and post-call webhooks are developer building blocks, not an export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
